name: Arkero
summary: Arkero is a VR fantasy MOBA where players master the Archer, Arbalist, or Mage classes. Hone your skills in a thrilling single-player hack-and-slash campaign, defend against relentless waves in co-op, or battle in strategic team-based PvP. Precision, skill, and teamwork define this VR experience, with an emphasis on competitive MOBA combat in a fully interactive fantasy world.
